title: Measuring Political Ad Tone
text: cm_comparisons dataset contains original crowd-coded pairwise comparisons Carlson & Montgomery (2017). can use estimate textscale scores directly without calls LLM.
code: # 1. Get embeddings for each ad emb <- get_embeddings(ad_tone$text)  # 2. Fit model on cm_comparisons (train set only by default) mod <- fit_model(cm_comparisons, emb)  # 3. Check model calibration against held-out ads validate_model(mod, cm_comparisons, emb)  # 4. Fit final model on all pairwise comparisons mod <- fit_model(cm_comparisons, emb, refit = TRUE)  # 5. Project scores scores <- score_documents(mod, emb, ci = TRUE)

title: Measure Latent Quantities from Text Using Pairwise Comparisons
text: annotated pair, textscale computes difference two document embeddings labels 1 document won 0 B won. ridge logistic regression fit differences identifies direction embedding space best separates winners losers — direction latent dimension. Projecting document’s embedding onto direction gives score, making straightforward scale new documents without additional LLM calls.

Controls fitting method used identify latent dimension. "ridge", "lasso", "enet" use glmnet::cv.glmnet() alpha 0, 1, alpha respectively. "svm" fits linear support vector machine via e1071::svm(). alpha elastic net mixing parameter, used method = "enet". Must 0 1 (0 = ridge, 1 = lasso). Defaults 0.5. nlambda Number lambda values evaluate cross-validation. Defaults 200. Ignored method = "svm". lambda_min_ratio Ratio smallest largest lambda evaluated. Defaults 1e-9. Increase see warning optimal lambda boundary search range. Ignored method = "svm". refit Logical. TRUE, comparisons used fitting regardless split column. Use validating train/test split produce final model trained full set annotations scoring documents. Defaults FALSE. ... Additional arguments passed glmnet::cv.glmnet() (glmnet methods) e1071::svm() (method = "svm").

text: model textscale_model object produced fit_model(). embeddings numeric matrix document embeddings score, one row per document. ci Logical. TRUE, return tibble score, lower, upper columns. Defaults FALSE. level Confidence level interval. Defaults 0.95. ci_method One "laplace" (default) "bootstrap". See Confidence interval methods details. n_boot Number bootstrap resamples. Defaults 500. Ignored ci_method = "laplace". comparisons Annotated comparisons tibble produced annotate_comparisons(). title: Score documents on the latent dimension — score_documents
text: ci = TRUE, tibble returned columns score, lower, upper instead plain numeric vector.

title: Score documents on the latent dimension — score_documents
text: "laplace" (default): Derives per-document score variances Laplace approximation posterior covariance beta: Var(score_i) = x_i' * (X'WX + lambda*)^{-1} * x_i, X matrix training embedding differences W diagonal matrix fitted working weights. fast (single matrix multiply) treats lambda fixed CV-selected value. available method = "svm" models. "bootstrap": Resamples training pairs replacement refits model n_boot times original fixed lambda, takes empirical quantiles resulting score distributions. Slower propagates sampling variability, works model types including "svm". Requires comparisons supplied.
